c.title: $8,000 / 2br - 1157ft2 - Furnished Kitsilano 2BR | Rooftop Patio + Solarium
c.description:
Available November 1 for a six-month stay, this fully furnished Kitsilano home offers approximately 1,157 sq ft with 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. The home includes a flexible upper solarium, furnished living areas, work space, artwork throughout, and several outdoor spaces.

Located near Kits Beach, the seawall, West 4th Avenue, restaurants, cafés, grocery stores, fitness studios, and other neighbourhood amenities.

🏠 About the Home

Approx. 1,157 sq ft
2 bedrooms
2 bathrooms
Upper bedroom/solarium suitable for guests, relaxing, or movie nights
Skylight and structural glass details
Primary bedroom with king-size bed and darkening curtains
Dedicated work-from-home area
Roche Bobois furnishings
Canadian and international artwork throughout
Fast TELUS fibre internet
In-suite washer and dryer

🌿 Outdoor + Living Areas

Covered lower patio
UV-filtered covering over the lower patio area
Outdoor fire feature with seating and entertaining space
Separate rooftop patio
Upper-level fireplace and mini fridge
BBQ setup
Multiple areas for outdoor dining, reading, relaxing, or entertaining

🍽 Kitchen

Fully furnished and equipped kitchen
Five-burner cooktop
Double ovens
Built-in microwave and dishwasher
Wine refrigeration
Vitamix, kettle, and coffee equipment
Food processor
Cookware and other kitchen essentials included

🛁 Bathrooms

Heated bathroom flooring
Custom bathroom finishes
Multi-directional shower jets

📍 Kitsilano Location

Close to Kits Beach, the seawall, West 4th Avenue, local restaurants, cafés, shopping, fitness options, and neighbourhood markets. The property offers easy access to the waterfront and everyday amenities in a residential setting.

💰 Rental Details

$8,000/month
Fully furnished
Available for 6 months starting November 1, 2026
No smoking
